summary: Refactored the Ollama server extension to a `createOllamaExtension({client, jobs, detectHost})` factory with a singleton export, added invoke-surface tests with stubbed dependencies, then iterated to green: fixed a registry race where runs resolving after cancellation were reported as 'succeeded' by also checking `signal.aborted` and making the stub reject on abort; corrected test fixtures (flat `qwen3.context_length` key, added `family` field) and resolved TypeScript errors (missing `open`/`access` imports, optional `signal` on the mirrored `invoke?`, explicit `JobSnapshot & { controller: AbortController }` job typing, `requestJson` accepting the `json` extension). Final `tsc --noEmit` is clean and vitest reports 37/37 passing for extensions/ollama, after which the work was committed as checkpoint 2.
decisions: Use a `createOllamaExtension({client?, jobs?, detectHost?})` factory with a `gizmoExtension` singleton so tests can inject dependencies.
In the job registry, a run that resolves after `signal.aborted` is treated as `cancelled` rather than `succeeded` (a pull that completed right as cancel arrived is acceptable to report cancelled).
Job object is explicitly typed as `JobSnapshot & { controller: AbortController }` with optional percent/message/error/finishedAt, so status can transition to `cancelled`/`failed` after construction.
The mirrored gizmo `invoke?` interface declares `signal?: AbortSignal` (optional) so callers can omit it.
`requestJson` signature widened to `RequestInit & { json?: unknown }` so call sites can pass the custom `json` extension through to `request`.
Stubbed `client.pull` mimics real fetch behavior by rejecting on abort rather than resolving, so cancellation semantics match production.

errors: vitest: 2 of 37 tests failed. 'lists models' — fixture used nested `model_info: { qwen3: { context_length: 40_960 } }` and sample model lacked `family`; fixed by flattening to `model_info: { "qwen3.context_length": 40_960 }` and adding `family: "qwen3"`. 'cancels an active pull' — stub resolved after abort so registry set status to 'succeeded'; fixed by making the stub reject on abort and having the registry treat a resolved-but-aborted run as cancelled.

tsc --noEmit errors: missing `access` import in host.ts (replaced when `open` was removed earlier — restored both `access` and `open`); invoke signature required `signal: AbortSignal` so `invoke!(..., undefined)` failed — made signal optional; `(signal => detectHost(client, signal))` lost its `AbortSignal` annotation; jobs.ts inferred `status: "running"` literally so assigning `"cancelled"`/`"failed"` and reading `error` failed — annotated job as `JobSnapshot & { controller: AbortController }`; `requestJson` typed as `RequestInit` so `{ json: ... }` triggered excess-property check — widened to `RequestInit & { json?: unknown }`.
